title: Qianxing worker frozen market specification set v1

markets.description: Map keyed by the complete canonical InstrumentId, including venue, for example BTC/USDT:USDT.OKX. Every entry is validated at runtime, including entries not selected by a particular worker, so a set can be shared safely by workers trading different subsets.

additionalProperties.description: One existing product market spec or normalized CCXT market spec. CCXT-shaped entries may include exact_rules with canonical decimal strings for contract_size, price_tick, quantity_step, minimum_quantity, and minimum_notional; runtime freezes these rules and compares them with refreshed venue metadata. Runtime loading verifies that the entry identity agrees with the InstrumentId key and validates its trading constraints.

dataset_instrument_role.description: Required by non-Paper Execution workers and must match the supplier-signed role catalog below. Index/unknown and role/product conflicts are rejected before live order submission.

dataset_instrument_role_catalog.description: Supplier-signed catalog proving the declared instrument role. Its signer key and supplier ID must be pinned in QX_DATASET_ROLE_TRUSTED_PUBLIC_KEYS.
